display.title: Episode 440: Torah, the Best Thing of All, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: Making the most of summer vacation, a whole family says the Shema in Studio 604, pirates attack Rabbi Akiva's ship, and a Havdalah quiz by phone.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens in the middle of summer vacation: a time to go outdoors and discover Hashem's beautiful world in parks, gardens and the countryside, and to stay safe by learning Torah, davening and giving tzedakah every day. He also tells listeners about the Tzivos Hashem hotline for finding a truly Jewish day camp or overnight camp. After the Hakochainik march, story time recaps how Rabbi Akiva told the merchants on his ship that his merchandise was worth more than all their gold. Before the new chapter, a whole family visits Studio 604: the children introduce themselves, recite the Shema, and thank their yeshiva and teachers. Then pirates attack the ship and carry off all the merchants' goods, but Rabbi Akiva stays calm, because the Torah he has learned can never be taken away. The merchants apologize and ask him to become their teacher. Mitzvah time continues the laws of Havdalah: we smell besamim to cheer us up when the extra Shabbos neshamah leaves. A young listener wins a braided Havdalah candle in a phone quiz. The show ends with tzedakah to bring the Geulah closer, an invitation to enroll in a yeshiva, candle-lighting times and the sponsor.
display.lesson: Torah is the most precious treasure: no one can take it away, and it goes with you wherever you go.
